gloss: to pay attention; to exercise caution

definitions.gloss: to pay attention; to exercise caution; to take care
definitions.explanation: To be careful and attentive about something. More deliberate and formal than simply 気をつける. The verb 払う (to pay) is used metaphorically here, as in English "to pay attention."

examples.japanese: {細部|さいぶ}にも{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う。
{健康|けんこう}にもっと{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}うべきだ。
examples.english: You should pay more attention to your health.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}の{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いには{十分|じゅうぶん}な{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Sufficient care must be taken in handling personal information.

notes:
PATTERN:
～に{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う (to pay attention to ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う (to pay sufficient attention)
- {細心|さいしん}の{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う (to pay the closest attention; to exercise utmost care)
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う{必要|ひつよう}がある (it is necessary to pay attention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}をつける: To be careful — more casual and common in everyday speech.
- {注意|ちゅうい}する: To be careful, to warn — simpler and broader. {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う is more deliberate and formal.
- {用心|ようじん}する: To be cautious, to take precautions — focuses on preventive measures against danger.
